question: In _________, it was decided by the Government of India to declare Indian languages ​​that meet the requirements of some as "classical languages".
solution:
The correct answer is** option 3)2004**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **article 343,** in India the official language of the country is Hindi in the **Devanagiri script.**
 
• In the year **2004**, it was decided by the **Government of India to declare Indian languages ​​that meet the requirements of some as "classical languages".**
 
• As per the **eight schedule** of the Indian constitution we have **22 languages **in India.
 
• With this in **2004, Tamil **was decided as the **classical language** of India by the Government of India.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Classical languages and their adopted years are as follows:

 
 

 **Tamil**
 **2004**
 
 

 **Kannada**
 **2008**
 
 

 **Sanskrit**
 **2005**
 
 

 **Telugu**
 **2008**
 
 

 **Malayalam**
 **2014**
 
 

 
• For a language to be classical, **it must be having an antiquity of history and if a valuable heritage is found it can be declared.**
 
• The** literary must be truely unique** for a classical language not a copied one.
